call.verdict_college: QUALIFIED — as a G6 starter — he is one now, his tackle production is top-third, and ten rooms at or above this level clear him. The coverage line caps the claim at this level rather than defeating it.
call.verdict_pro: NOT QUALIFIED YET — the tackling and blitzing production is a signing profile; the coverage outcomes are not, and NFL linebacker signings from this level are coverage signings. The file qualifies him for a look, not yet for the claim.
call.lever_college: The claim above this one — starting at P4 — needs the coverage line repaired: a rating allowed under 100 with actual ball production. That single split is the whole difference between his likely rung and his ceiling.
call.lever_pro: One season of league-average coverage outcomes (rating allowed under 100, two or more takeaways on the ball) plus a verified pro-day number. His final season can supply both.
